lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a multi-linear grid posterior to the branchial region. Centroids form approximately six visible vertical columns with horizontal alignment along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, particularly prominent in the mid-flank region, creating defined nodes at the intersection of vertical stripes and horizontal alignments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge of the ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped notch is visible on the leading edge of the first dorsal fin. Additional irregular indentation is present on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin near the apex.
